business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid civil law system with a strong common-law overlay in corporate and maritime law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force 31 October 2012, Chapter 10 on Investment

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015, as amended from time to time, establishing Panama's comprehensive AML/CFT framework; Executive Decree No. 128 of 2015 implementing regulatory due diligence and reporting obligations; Executive Decree No. 363 of 27 June 2016, as amended, establishing the 'Registro de Beneficiarios Finales' (Ultimate Beneficial Owner Registry) at the Registro Público de Panamá; Law No. 4 of 2015 regulating Registered Agents and their UBO investigation duties; Law No. 32 of 1927, the General Corporation Law of Panama.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization at a Panamanian Embassy or Consulate for non-Apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Bylaws of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and/or competent registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization at a Panamanian Embassy or Consulate for non-Apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Panamanian Registered Agent and incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction or Panamanian Consul abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization at a Panamanian Embassy or Consulate for non-Apostille countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn Declaration of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final) for each natural-person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian Notary Public if executed in Panama, or notary public/competent authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization at a Panamanian Embassy or Consulate for non-Apostille countries

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, signatories, and counterparties against OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, and applicable Panamanian domestic regulatory sanctions lists. Politically Exposed Persons include both domestic and foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates. Enhanced Due Diligence is required for high-risk pharmaceutical API distribution, including source-of-wealth checks and adverse media review per Law No. 23 of 2015 and UAF/Financial Intelligence Unit guidelines.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas; online name reservation via https://www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the official language. Corporate names must use Latin script; foreign-language names are permitted but must be transliterated into Latin characters and, when requested by the Registry, accompanied by a Spanish translation. The corporate suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' must be included.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may not be administratively extended; the applicant may re-file for the same name before expiry. If the name is rejected, the Panamanian Registered Agent may file an 'escrito de reconsideración' with the Director of the Personas Jurídicas section within five business days. If reconsideration is denied, a further 'recurso de apelación' may be filed before the Director General of the Registro Público. A protective alternate name should be filed simultaneously to avoid loss of priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is permitted for the statutory registered office of a Panama Sociedad Anónima because Panama law requires a local Registered Agent with a physical address for service. However, for ISIC 4649 wholesale distribution of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, the Ministry of Health (MINSA) and the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs require a physically accessible operational warehouse and storage facility; a purely virtual office will not satisfy sanitary licensing or import permit requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. Approximately 70% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Ministry of Health within the first 12 months after obtaining the pharmaceutical wholesale/sanitary import license, and a continuing risk of annual periodic and complaint-based inspections.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 sobre Sociedades Anónimas (as amended), Articles 2–20 and 61–65; Código de Comercio de Panamá, Title I, Articles 124–150; Decreto de Gabinete No. 5 de 2003 (Registro Público de Panamá).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (RPP) — Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas, Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución with attached Acta Constitutiva y Estatutos, presented for inscription as the Ficha Registral
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum authorized capital of US$10,000; no mandatory paid-up capital at incorporation and no statutory escrow or bank-escrow deposit requirement; shares may be paid in cash or non-cash consideration per Ley No. 32 de 1927.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], S.A., REPUBLIC OF PANAMA. RESOLVED: (1) that the Company issues and subscribes ten thousand (10,000) ordinary common shares, par value US$1.00 each, fully paid up, to the founding subscriber; (2) that the registered office is established at [ADDRESS], Panama City, Republic of Panama; (3) that [NAME], [NAME] and [NAME] are appointed President, Treasurer and Secretary, respectively; (4) that the President and Treasurer are jointly authorized to open corporate bank accounts, execute the municipal operating license application, and pay all incorporation and franchise taxes; and (5) that this Resolution be entered in the corporate minute book. Certified by the Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Registro de Nombres (in-person window at Ciudad de Panamá or online Sede Electrónica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three alternative corporate names, in order of preference, using the official name-reservation form; pay the tariff corresponding to the name search; obtain the Certificado de Registro de Nombre, which is valid for 60 business days and must accompany the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Downloaded name-reservation request form
Copy of passport of the applicant or resident agent
DGI codified seal (estampilla) if applicable
Registro Público tariff payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to a registered company, the applicant may file a written reconsideration with the Departamento de Registro de Nombres; alternatively, one of the two remaining reserved names may be used without an additional search fee, provided the 60-business-day validity has not lapsed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (licensed Panamanian notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage the resident agent to prepare the Escritura Pública de Constitución incorporating the Acta Constitutiva y Estatutos in accordance with Ley No. 32 de 1927; the incorporators, or their attorney-in-fact, must appear before the notary; the notary authenticates the instrument, seals it, and issues certified copies for presentation to the Registro Público.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation (Acta Constitutiva y Estatutos)
Certificado de Registro de Nombre issued by the Registro Público
Notarized power of attorney if the incorporator is represented
Valid passports, residence identity card, or NIT of subscribers
Statement of designated resident agent and registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial defects are cured by executing a clarifying deed (Escritura de Aclaración y Corrección) before the same notary and re-presenting it to the Registro Público; if the articles contain substantive statutory omissions, the notary restamps the corrected deed and the evidentiary fee is recalculated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Corporation at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas (Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original Escritura Pública and certified copies to the Mercantile Section for examination; the Registry verifies name availability, statutory content, and payment of tariffs; upon approval, the society is inscribed in the Mercantile Ledger and the certified Ficha Registral is issued.
required_dossiers: Original Escritura Pública de Constitución
Certificado de Registro de Nombre
Registro Público tariff payment receipt
Authenticated power of attorney for the resident agent
Ficha de inscripción template prepared by the registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner issues a preventive observation (preventiva), the resident agent has 30 calendar days to file the requested clarifications or rectifying deed; failure to comply causes the filing to be archived, and a new filing is then required with a fresh fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUC/NIT) with the National Tax Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Ficha Única de Contribuyente online through DGI's Sede Electrónica or at a DGI regional office; attach the incorporated Ficha Registral and articles; DGI assigns the RUC/NIT and activates territorial income tax registration; request authorization of electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) for wholesale pharmaceutical transactions.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Ficha Registral (inscription certificate)
Copy of registered Estatutos
Municipal operating license (Aviso de Operación) or promise of the same
Passport or ID card of the legal representative
Proof of registered office address (lease deed or utility bill)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Corrections are processed by a solicitud de rectificación filed with DGI; where DGI denies or conditions registration, the taxpayer may file an administrative appeal under the Código de Procedimiento Tributario before the Tribunal Administrativo Tributario within 15 working days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá — Dirección General de Rentas, Ventanilla Única de Atención al Contribuyente
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación form, declaration of estimated gross receipts, and commercial premises data at the municipality where the warehouse is located; pay the municipal license fee (impuesto de aviso de operación) calculated on declared projected revenue; the municipality issues the operating license evidencing lawful commercial establishment.
required_dossiers: Completed Aviso de Operación application form
Certified copy of the Ficha Registral and Estatutos
RUC/NIT certificate issued by DGI
Floor plan and lease agreement of the warehouse premises
Identity document of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Denials may be contested by a recurso de apelación filed with the Alcaldía within five working days; if the refusal is caused by inconsistent gross receipts declarations, an amended sworn declaration may cure the discrepancy, subject to graduated recalculation of license fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sanitary Operating License for the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Salud de Panamá (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DNFD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for the Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento for a drug distribution establishment, attaching the premises documentation, Good Storage Practices manual, and appointment of a Regente (pharmacist in charge); upon positive pre-evaluation, DNFD inspectors verify the warehouse; the sanitary license is issued and must be displayed at the registered premises.
required_dossiers: DNFD sanitary license application form
RUC/NIT and municipal Aviso de Operación
Academic and professional qualification of the Regente Farmacéutico
Good Storage Practices (BPM) manual for API and pharmaceutical products
Warehouse floor plan and lease deed
Cold-chain certification if temperature-controlled APIs are distributed
MiAMBIENTE environmental registration for low-impact storage (if demanded)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A denied sanitary license may be appealed by a reconsideration petition to the Director of the DNFD within 15 working days; corrective actions identified during inspection give rise to a single reinspection without additional fee if completed within 30 days; egregious non-compliance requires a new application and full inspection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with Social Security and Occupational Risk System
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) — Dirección Nacional de Afiliación y Registro; co-registrar for occupational risk: CSS Departamento de Riesgos Profesionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. as an employer with CSS through the employer registration module, filing the payroll form and schedule of employees; the employer enters the Riesgos Profesionales occupational risk regime and selects a recognized insurer for workplace risk coverage; if no staff are initially hired, submit a sworn declaration of zero payroll.
required_dossiers: RUC/NIT certificate of the S.A.
Certified copy of the Ficha Registral
Employer registration form (CSS Formulario de Inscripción del Empleador)
Payroll schedule of employees
Lease deed of registered premises
Identity documents of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Administrative objections by CSS are addressed through reconsideration filed with the Dirección Nacional de Afiliación; late-filing penalties on payroll declarations may be waived upon proof of first-time employer registration and absence of personnel during the formation stage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud de Panamá (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DNFD), in coordination with Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) and the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Droguería, Distribuidora de Medicamentos e Insumos Farmacéuticos (incl. active pharmaceutical ingredients)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental (successor of ANAM)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III – low-impact environmental notification (Aviso/Informe de Impacto Ambiental), not a full EIA Report; a full Category II EIA is triggered only where the warehouse exceeds 1,000 m2, involves extensive hazardous waste storage, or installs wastewater pretreatment systems.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Decreto Ejecutivo No. 85 de 2004 (pH 6.0–9.0; BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L; COD ≤ 500 mg/L; TSS ≤ 150 mg/L; fats/oils ≤ 30 mg/L); pharmaceutical waste and expired APIs must be segregated as hazardous residues under Ley No. 66 de 2014, stored in covered licensed containers, and removed by MiAMBIENTE-authorized haulers under manifest; VOC emissions from solvents require local exhaust and MiAMBIENTE-verified air quality compliance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (inspección contra incendios and smoke/fire alarm verification), structural load inspection of the warehouse by the municipal engineering office, workplace safety clearance from the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL), and municipal building occupancy permit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; taxpayer portal: DGI electronic services portal (e-Tax and electronic invoicing systems at dgi.mef.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panama Sociedad Anónima: after incorporation at the Public Registry, the company or its resident legal representative must apply to DGI for an RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) using Form RUC-1, accompanied by public registry certificate, articles of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, fiscal address proof, required government fees, and, for non-resident persons acting on behalf of the entity, notarized power of attorney or 2025 electronic credential authorisation. If the company is a non-resident person/entity deriving Panama-source income, it must also obtain a RUC through a licensed abogado or registered agent and may be required to appoint a resident agent. A digital signature certificate must be obtained before activating e-invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity election comparable to US IRC §7701. A Sociedad Anónima is taxable as a juridical separate person at entity level exclusively on Panama-source income. Options available: (1) election to be treated under the simplified small taxpayer (Pequeño Contribuyente) ITBMS regime where annual gross receipts meet the statutory threshold, subject to prior DGI authorization; (2) election by a foreign legal person to operate its Panamanian trade through a regulated branch (sucursal) rather than a local S.A.; (3) election to apply the optional special fiscal incentive regimes applicable to certain export/service activities. No general consolidation, look-through, or classification election is otherwise available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS – Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Panama VAT-style transfer tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for ITBMS registration: any person obliged to pay ITBMS in respect of Panamanian taxable services or goods must register with DGI before commencing operations. A reduced-definition Pequeño Contribuyente regime may be elected when annual gross receipts are equal to or below B/. 36,000, subject to DGI approval and restrictions on input tax credits.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing for all RUC holders through the DGI electronic invoicing system (Facturación Electrónica) or certified third-party providers. Invoices must be digitally signed with the taxpayer’s digital certificate and transmitted to DGI in real time or through approved batch/API channels for fiscal validation before issuance; no unsystematic manual invoices are acceptable for formal wholesalers. DGI performs automatic validation, assigns invoice acceptance numbers, and rejects non-conforming documents. Customs/export-related electronic documentation must be coordinated with the Panama customs system (SICE) for exports of pharmaceutical APIs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods, including active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), are subject to 0% ITBMS if the goods physically leave Panamanian customs territory and are sold to a non-resident purchaser for use outside Panama. The exporter must be the registered RUC holder and must maintain proof of ownership, actual shipment, and receipt of payment in foreign currency or US dollars. Services performed in Panama for a non-resident and wholly consumed abroad are also zero-rated to the extent supported by contractual, delivery and payment evidence. Goods introduced into Colon Free Zone or other free trade zones are treated as exempt/zero-rated, but subsequent local sale in Panama enters Panama-sourced territory. DGI requires the exporter to retain all substantiation for the statutory prescription period and may condition refund/credit entitlement on verified clearance and FX repatriation evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Exit Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera / SICE export permit)
Through Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Panamanian port/airport
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT bank confirmation evidencing receipt of payment from the foreign buyer
Commercial invoice with despcription of pharmaceutical APIs and terms of sale (CIF/FOB)
Purchase/procurement records evidencing the exporter's ownership of the goods
Regulatory/pharma export clearance evidence if required by Ministerio de Salud or Panama customs
Free Trade Zone certificate, if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI may audit export zero-rating transactions for up to the full statute of limitations; where a purported export is found not to have been physically exported, to have been delivered in Panama, or to lack genuine payment evidence, the ITBMS becomes payable at 7% on the gross consideration, with default interest, surcharges, and late-payment penalties. Administrative penalties under the Fiscal Code may range up to twice or more of the omitted tax; criminal tax and customs fraud sanctions, including imprisonment and disqualification of directors/legal representatives, may be imposed on responsible persons. Retrospective clawback may also extend to credits or refunds already claimed for the relevant periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the sole banking and financial-system supervisor. Panama has no central bank and no monetary authority; the US Dollar (USD) is full legal tender under Decree Law No. 15 of 1904, and the Panamanian Balboa exists only as fractional coinage pegged 1:1 to USD. Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent of the State, while the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) handles fiscal policy. Foreign-exchange administration is absent by design; the SBP regulates AML/CFT conduct of banks and the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) supervises suspicious-transaction reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility with zero exchange controls. Panama operates a de facto dollarized open capital account: current-account payments (imports, services, royalties, interest) and capital-account flows (equity injections, loan disbursements, dividends, loan repayments) require no prior central-bank authorization, no repatriation licence, and no currency-conversion mandate. The sole profit-remittance hurdle is territorial-source taxation: distributions of Panama-source taxable profits to shareholders attract a 10% dividend withholding tax (5% for small taxpayers qualifying under the simplified regime), whereas distributions out of foreign-source or non-taxable profits are exempt. No impediment, queue, tax-clearance certificate, or government pre-approval attaches to dividend wires by the treasury bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory timeline, no minimum conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export receipts or pharmaceutical API trade receivables. Export proceeds may remain held offshore in USD or any fully convertible currency indefinitely. The only compliance layer is documentary: the SBP-regulated bank will expect underlying invoice, customs-export declaration, and transportation-document consistency for the treasury account's expected credit pattern, and the UAF reporting threshold applies to suspicious movements rather than to repatriation of proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Multi-currency Treasury and Trade Finance
Operational Account / Commercial LC and Trust Services
Operational Account / Fiscal-Agency Escrow and Public Tender Settlement
Operational Account / Regional USD Clearing and Collections
International Wholesale / Trust and Corporate Services Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a standalone liquidity node; MEDIUM only as a supplementary low-value collections/disbursements channel. Under Law 81 of 2021 (Panama Financial Innovation Regime), e-money issuance, PSP licensing, and open-banking sandbox participation require SBP authorization; unlicensed offshore digital EMIs cannot lawfully maintain a local omnibus settlement account or on-board the Panamanian S.A. without triggering the SBP bank's correspondent-account AML risk. The optimal structure is to use a fully licensed SBP-regulated bank as the central treasury concentration point and treasury-signing node, and to interface with a foreign EMI solely for small-ticket transactions (freight prepayments, ancillary logistics, sample purchases) through the bank's approved API payment-initiation rails, never concentrating more than 10% of monthly liquidity outside the SBP banking perimeter, thereby preserving the corporate veil and avoiding FATF-related jurisdictional rating harm to the Sociedad Anónima.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory for this risk profile. SBP Acuerdo No. 2 de 2020 (Due Diligence Regulation) and the 2015 AML/CFT framework require financial institutions to identify the client and every Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) via independent, reliable and, for higher-risk commercial customers, in-person verification. A Panama S.A. conducting pharmaceutical API wholesale (classified by the SBP as a high-risk / special-licence sector) will in practice face: (1) physical appearance of each authorized signatory and each UBO at the bank's Panamanian office, or, exceptionally, before a Panamanian Notary or Panamanian Consul abroad with apostilled identity documents and a certified live signature; (2) notarized and apostilled corporate resolution designating account signatories; (3) bank reference letters from the existing shareholder or related corporate accounts; (4) a face-to-face interview covering source of funds, trade route map, ultimate consignees, controlled-substance compliance, and expected transaction volume; (5) certified copies of the resident-agent certificate, articles of incorporation, and share registry. Remote/digital-only opening is not viable for the initial corporate treasury account; remote signing may be layered only after the first in-person KYC is completed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legacy bearer shares or undisclosed UBO chain under Panama Law 23 of 2015 and the 2016 corporate-transparency amendments, or nominee shareholder opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn declaration de Beneficiario Final (UBO questionnaire) executed by all natural-person principals; notarized and apostilled share register evidencing that any bearer certificates are immobilized or cancelled and held with a licensed custody institution; legal opinion from independent Panamanian counsel confirming share custody, signatory powers, and absence of bearer instruments; updated resident-agent certificate and Certified Copy of the corporate register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or high-jurisdiction exposure: API transactions with Latin American transshipment through the Colón Free Zone, or counterparties in Venezuela, Cuba, Syria, Iran, or Russia-linked distribution chains.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC, UN, EU, and Panamanian UAF screening reports for all shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, and ultimate consignees; confirmation that no 50% or more aggregate ownership is held by sanctioned persons; executed end-user certificates and ultimate-consignee declarations; customs-broker mandates; B/L, AWB, packing lists, and container-tracking records proving each shipment's physical route and consistent use of documentary credits or direct wire purpose codes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Deficient pharmaceutical licensing: absence of MINSA - Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DNFD) wholesaler import/distribution licence, or lack of controlled-substance permit where APIs are regulated precursors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current DNFD pharmaceutical wholesale or import licence; controlled-substance import/export permit (if any API or precursor falls within the controlled list); WHO-GMP / PIC/S certificates of each API manufacturing plant; batch-specific Certificates of Analysis; destination-country product registrations or exemption letters; customs declarations filed with the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) proving lawful entry to Panama or compliant transshipment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, thin-margin USD flows inconsistent with a pharmaceutical API wholesale commercial profile (e.g., rapid in-and-out wires, round-dollar amounts, or same-day layering).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of audited financial statements evidencing gross margin, inventory turnover, warehouse costs, and operating expenses typical of a wholesale API distributor; executed master purchase agreements (FOB/CIF) and master distribution agreements with named licensed laboratories; 12-month cash-flow forecast reconciled to supplier LC schedules and buyer credit terms; payroll, insurance, and logistics contracts substantiating the cost base; bank-account transaction-limitation undertaking and defined third-party-payment prohibition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-jurisdiction payment chains requiring disbursement to a supplier's third-party intermediary or an affiliated trading company in a non-manufacturing jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Single-beneficiary, single-purpose wire policy; group-structure chart with legal documentation for all intermediary entities (certificate of incorporation, UBO register, licensed status); invoice trail matching each disbursement to a named original manufacturer; inspection certificates (SGS, Intertek, Bureau Veritas) and pre-shipment survey reports for every LC drawdown or wire above the bank's threshold.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: inbound equity contributions from the shareholder's account are transmitted by SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for same-bank interbank) to the S.A.'s USD treasury account at its SBP-regulated bank, with the reference field clearly stating 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' / 'APORTE DE CAPITAL'. Panama maintains no statutory purpose-code matrix requiring government approval; however, the bank will internally code the credit under its transaction-classification framework (equity/trust-services category) and will request, for credits equal to or above USD 500,000 or involving a 10%+ UBO, a 'source of wealth' questionnaire, the executed capital-subscription minutes, and the updated share register matching the declared beneficial owners. No exchange-control certificate, no CBP (banking clearance), and no tax clearance is required; only standard OFAC/UN sanctions screening, UAF recording, and bank-internal AML checks apply. For escrow-backed injections, the bank accepts the escrow agreement, subscription undertaking, and funds-origin letter from the escrow agent as sufficient documentary basis.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: API import purchases from India, China, or EU suppliers are executed via (1) irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700/MT720) for larger shipments, with presentation of full set of clean-on-board B/L or AWB, commercial invoice, packing list, Certificate of Analysis, WHO-GMP certificate, and any destination-country registration at the LC counters; (2) Documentary Collections (DP/DA) for tested recurring counterparties; (3) direct SWIFT MT103 USD wire transfers cleared through the Panamanian bank's US correspondent (Fedwire/CHIPS) via ABA routing and CHIPS UID, with the invoice number and DNFD import-record references in the remittance information. All trade settlements must be reconciled to the ANA customs declarations and to the MINSA/DNFD import documentation trail in the corporate treasury file. For pharmaceutical API goods classified as controlled substances or listed precursors, disbursements will require the DNFD controlled-substance import permit to be presented to the bank in advance before the wire or LC is released.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/CHF) - fully deliverable, no SBP restriction; appropriate for firm API purchase commitments from European suppliers.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on restrained currencies (USD/CNY-CNH, USD/INR, USD/KRW, USD/PHP, USD/IDR) - permitted via the bank's international correspondent desk; no local deliverability requirement; used to hedge Chinese and Indian API manufacturer payables.
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCIRS) - permitted for restructuring multi-year supplier credit lines or equipment-financing tranches denominated in EUR/CHF/INR.
European-style FX Options (USD/EUR and USD/CNH calls and puts) - permitted for hedging discrete tender or bid exposure on API bulk supply contracts.
FX Swaps / Rolling FX Swaps - permitted for short-dated swap between USD and EUR/CHF to fund trade prepayments, letter-of-credit collateral, or inventory finance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Sociedad Anónima annual corporate franchise tax ('Anualidad') — payment and online DGI settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually on or before December 31 of each calendar year; first-year fee is settled at incorporation and subsequent fees follow the calendar annual cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues DGI statutory interest plus graduated surcharges; the entity is flagged on the DGI delinquent list, public registry certificates are blocked, and prolonged non-payment can trigger compulsory collection and administrative dissolution by the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered agent annual AML file refresh and ultimate beneficial owner confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Beneficial Owners Registry; Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) for AML supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual AML refresh on corporate anniversary; any change in shareholders or ultimate beneficial owners reported to the DGI registry within 30 calendar days of the transfer or change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update UBO or AML records exposes the entity and its resident agent to administrative fines under Law 23 of 2015, up to USD 1,000,000 for aggravated AML breaches; continuing non-compliance may render the agent unable to lawfully represent the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Aviso de Operación and MINSA pharmaceutical wholesale license annual renewal (conditional on Panamanian-source operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipalidad of the registered operating address; Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacias y Drogas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Aviso de Operación renewal generally due within the first quarter following the fiscal year; pharmaceutical wholesale sanitary license renewal follows the MINSA anniversary calendar and is due before expiry of the existing permit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Renewal failure triggers administrative fines up to USD 5,000, closure orders, suspension of pharmaceutical wholesale activities, and prohibition of API imports or exports until permits are reinstated.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Panamanian S.A. is not required to undergo an independent statutory audit unless it operates in Panama and exceeds DGI's fiscal-audit ('dictamen fiscal') threshold — generally annual gross revenue exceeding USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceeding USD 3,000,000 — or it is a regulated bank, insurer, securities issuer, or public-interest entity. Pure offshore S.A.s with non-Panamanian sources are exempt from mandatory audit absent contractual or regulatory requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB applies to companies obliged to prepare general-purpose financial statements in Panama; non-public entities may apply Panamanian Local GAAP provided records remain sufficient for territorial income tax administration.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panama does not impose a universal annual UBO return; however, the resident agent must maintain current beneficial-owner information, report any shareholding transfer to the DGI Beneficial Owners Registry within 30 calendar days, and perform an annual AML client file refresh before the corporate anniversary under Law 23 of 2015. Failure to confirm the UBO annually is treated as an AML compliance breach.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sectoral CIT incentive for pharmaceutical API wholesale; flat 25% rate applies for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2021. Territorial exclusion may remove foreign-source trading income from the gross base where sale, delivery, and payment occur outside Panama. Optional regimes: SEM (Multinational Headquarters License) at 5% on qualifying Panama-source income with dividend exemption; Colon Free Zone / Panama Pacifico at reduced effective rates for qualifying re-export and logistics operations. The 1.5% IMC (Impuesto Mínimo a Pagar) on gross taxable income operates as a minimum effective burden and is creditable against the standard CIT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 111 – Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed via the DGI electronic portal (DGI Virtual / e-Tax, dgi.mef.gob.pa). The transfer-pricing informational annex and audited financial statements are transmitted together with Form 111 where applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. Quarterly advance income tax payments (pagos anticipados) are made during the fiscal year; large taxpayers also file monthly ITBMS/VAT declarations and, when applicable, monthly IMC advances.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed no later than the third month following fiscal year-end; calendar-year corporations must file by 31 March of the immediately following year. DGI-approved extensions may defer only the filing, not the payment of the tax due.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyente of the Panamanian S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident taxpayer with a Panamanian PE or Panama-source income must first obtain a RUC through a domiciled legal representative before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indicate the fiscal year covered (e.g., 01/01/2024 through 31/12/2024).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident PE must use the same fiscal-year definition as the foreign head office if previously approved by the DGI; otherwise the calendar year applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Main ISIC/NAICS activity code; for wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical APIs use NAICS 424210 / ISIC 4649.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must select the code of the Panamanian PE activity, not the foreign parent's general industrial classification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross invoices from API sales where the goods, services, or delivery are sourced in Panama and fall within Panama's territorial taxation rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude pure foreign-trade income attributable to transactions performed entirely abroad; attach a reconciliation note substantiating the exclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income excluded under territoriality, tax treaties, or special regimes such as SEM, Colon Free Zone, or Panama Pacifico.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident PE reports only Panama-source income; foreign-source income of the head office must not be included in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recorded cost of API inventories, freight, customs, storage, commissions, salaries, and operating expenses, supported by valid invoices and compliant accounting records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must allocate head-office overhead to the PE under arm's-length principles; intercompany purchases require transfer-pricing support to remain deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source income less deductible costs and expenses, reduced by any net operating loss carryforward (maximum 5 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE net taxable base must be expressed in Balboas/USD; foreign-exchange gains or losses must follow the Fiscal Code source and timing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 25% CIT rate to net taxable income and compare against 1.5% IMC on gross taxable income, taking the higher of the two as the payable corporate tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident PE is subject to the same 25% rate; subsequent repatriation of PE profits attracts dividend withholding treatment at the point of remittance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for taxes withheld by counterparties, quarterly advance payments, and IMC amounts already paid during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must attach the withholding certificates issued by Panamanian paying agents and a computation of foreign tax credits only if covered by a DTA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment triggers a 10% surcharge on the unpaid tax plus statutory interest at 1% per month or fraction thereof. Non-filing fines range from B/. 25 to B/. 5,000; persistent default results in RUC suspension, closure of the commercial license, and potential criminal prosecution for tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final dividend withholding on distributions paid from profits already subject to Panamanian CIT; 15% total (10% statutory dividend tax plus 5% complementary levy) when the distributed profits derive from exempt or non-subject income. The payor Panamanian S.A. applies the withholding equally to resident and non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a DTA, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the home country covering the relevant payment date; (2) provide a Spanish translation and apostille/legalization when required by the DGI; (3) deliver the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the Panamanian paying company before the dividend distribution; (4) the paying company applies the reduced treaty rate; and (5) the paying company submits the TRC, affidavit, and supporting documentation to the DGI within 10 business days after the payment or credit. In higher-risk cases, the DGI may require prior approval. Panama applies BEPS MLI-derived Principal Purpose Test standards, so the shareholder must demonstrate genuine economic substance and the absence of treaty-shopping intent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for intellectual property rights exploited in Panama carry a 12.5% statutory final withholding on gross payments to non-residents; several DTAs (including Mexico, Netherlands, UK, Spain, UAE, and Portugal) reduce royalty withholding to 10%, and certain copyright/trade-license categories to 5% or 0%. Interest paid to non-resident commercial lenders is generally not subject to Panamanian withholding under territorial source rules and the Fiscal Code exemptions for arms-length financial loans; treaty interaction is therefore neutral, with the effective foreign interest WHT at 0% subject to beneficial-ownership and thin-capitalization verification.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Panama uses the Balboa (PAB), pegged 1:1 to the USD. The annual Transfer-Pricing Informational Return is mandatory when related-party transactions in the fiscal year exceed B/. 250,000. The Local File (Informe Local) is required when related-party transactions exceed B/. 2,000,000. The Master File (Informe Maestro) is required when the multinational group's worldwide consolidated revenue exceeds B/. 50,000,000 and the taxpayer meets the Local File threshold. Documentation must be contemporaneous, in Spanish, and delivered to the DGI within the filing period or upon tax audit request.
